name: Deep Groove Ball Bearing
description: Single-row deep groove ball bearing with 120 mm outer diameter, 45 mm inner bore, 20 mm width, hardened chrome steel construction and stamped steel cage with 8 precision ground steel balls.

name: Tapered Roller Bearing
description: Heavy-duty tapered roller bearing with 150 mm OD, 70 mm bore, carburized alloy steel cups and rollers, designed for combined radial and axial thrust loads in automotive transmissions.

name: Spherical Thrust Bearing
description: Self-aligning spherical roller thrust bearing with 180 mm OD, 90 mm shaft diameter, brass cage, hardened bearing steel races, suitable for vertical hydro-turbines.

name: Needle Roller Bearing
description: Compact drawn cup needle roller bearing with 35 mm OD, 28 mm shaft bore, 16 mm width, hardened steel needle rollers, thin-walled precision stamped outer ring.

name: Spur Gear 36T
description: Custom mechanical spur gear with 36 teeth, 100 mm outer diameter, 25 mm central bore, 15 mm face width, machined keyway and hardened steel finish.

name: Helical Pinion Gear
description: Precision helical gear with 24 teeth, 20-degree helix angle, 85 mm pitch diameter, 30 mm keyed shaft bore, carburized alloy steel 8620, ground tooth flanks.

name: Bevel Gear Set
description: Straight bevel gear with 30 teeth, 90-degree shaft intersection, 120 mm pitch diameter, 35 mm bore, forged alloy steel with black oxide surface finish.

name: Worm Gear Wheel
description: Bronze worm wheel gear with 40 teeth, 140 mm pitch diameter, 32 mm central bore, phosphor bronze rim cast onto cast iron hub for high-torque reduction.

name: Planetary Sun Gear
description: Compact planetary gearset sun gear with 18 external involute teeth, 50 mm OD, splined central internal bore, nitrided tool steel finish.

name: Timing Belt Sprocket
description: HTD 8M timing belt pulley sprocket with 48 teeth, 122 mm OD, dual retaining side flanges, 20 mm pilot bore, 6061-T6 clear anodized aluminum.

name: Centrifugal Water Pump
description: Industrial centrifugal water pump with stainless steel 316 volute casing, circular axial suction inlet, tangential vertical side discharge outlet, and four-bolt mounting base.

name: Hydraulic External Gear Pump
description: High-pressure external gear pump with extruded aluminum body, cast iron end plates, SAE 2-bolt mounting flange, 5/8-inch keyed drive shaft, SAE O-ring ports.

name: Peristaltic Metering Pump
description: Chemical dosing peristaltic pump head with transparent polycarbonate cover, 3-roller rotor assembly, stainless steel tube compression track, quick-release clamps.

name: Multistage Centrifugal Impeller
description: Closed centrifugal pump impeller with 6 backward-curved vanes, 175 mm outer diameter, 30 mm keyed hub bore, precision investment cast 304 stainless steel.

name: Rotary Vane Vacuum Pump
description: Oil-sealed rotary vane vacuum pump module with cast iron stator housing, eccentric cylindrical rotor with spring-loaded carbon vanes, integrated exhaust mist filter.

name: High-Pressure Ball Valve
description: Two-piece stainless steel 316 ball valve with 50 mm flanged port ends, mirror-polished floating spherical ball, PTFE valve seats, 90-degree manual lever handle.

name: Industrial Butterfly Valve
description: Wafer-style butterfly valve with ductile iron body, 150 mm nominal diameter, 316 stainless steel disc, EPDM resilient liner seat, top ISO 5211 actuator mounting pad.

name: Swing Check Valve
description: Cast steel swing check valve with bolted bonnet, 80 mm flanged pipeline connections, stellite hardfaced seating surface, internal pivoting clapper disc.

name: Needle Metering Valve
description: Precision brass needle valve with 1/4-inch NPT threaded female connections, knurled micrometer adjustment knob, tapered carbide needle stem for fine flow control.

name: Piping Weld Neck Flange
description: ANSI Class 150 weld neck pipe flange with 190 mm outer diameter, 60 mm bore, raised sealing face, 8 bolt holes on 152 mm bolt circle diameter, forged carbon steel A105.

name: Blind Flange with O-Ring
description: Solid blind pipe flange with 165 mm outer diameter, 22 mm thickness, 4 bolt holes, machined face O-ring groove, 304 stainless steel passivated finish.

name: Flexible Jaw Coupling
description: Three-piece elastomeric jaw coupling assembly with 65 mm OD, polyurethane curved spider insert, two curved cast iron hubs with 24 mm keyed shaft bores.

name: Oldham Shaft Coupling
description: Zero-backlash Oldham coupling with two aluminum clamping hubs and center sliding acetal disc, 40 mm OD, accommodating parallel shaft misalignment.

name: NEMA 4X Electrical Enclosure
description: Wall-mount industrial electrical enclosure box, 300 mm x 250 mm x 150 mm, 304 stainless steel with continuous polyurethane door gasket, quarter-turn key latch, external mounting feet.

name: Modular DIN-Rail Enclosure
description: Flame-retardant polycarbonate DIN-rail electronics enclosure, 105 mm width, ventilated top face, snap-together base with pluggable terminal block openings.

name: Explosion-Proof Junction Box
description: Heavy sand-cast aluminum explosion-proof junction box, Class I Div 1 rated, threaded screw-on circular cover, four 3/4-inch NPT conduit entry hubs.

name: Pneumatic Double-Acting Cylinder
description: ISO 15552 pneumatic cylinder with 50 mm bore, 150 mm stroke, anodized aluminum profile barrel with T-slots, hard chrome-plated steel piston rod, adjustable end cushioning.

name: NEMA 23 Stepper Motor
description: Hybrid stepping motor with NEMA 23 square 57 mm mounting face, 4 threaded mounting holes, 6.35 mm D-shaft, black epoxy coated stator body, 4-pin connector.

name: Industrial Linear Ball Screw
description: Precision ground linear ball screw with 20 mm screw shaft diameter, 5 mm lead, flanged recirculating ball nut with wiper seals, machined bearing journal ends.

name: Linear Motion Guide Block
description: Profile linear guide rail carriage block with 4-row recirculating ball tracks, grease zerk fitting, ground reference datum edges, hardened bearing steel.

name: Liquid Cold Plate Heat Exchanger
description: Micro-channel liquid cooling cold plate, 180 mm x 100 mm x 16 mm, nickel-plated copper base with vacuum-brazed aluminum cover and dual push-in barb fittings.

name: Extruded Aluminum Heatsink
description: High-aspect-ratio extruded aluminum heatsink profile, 150 mm length, 100 mm width, 40 mm height with 16 vertical cooling fins, black anodized finish.

name: Engine Exhaust Manifold
description: Cast ductile iron 4-into-1 exhaust manifold header with flat CNC-surfaced cylinder head mounting flange and 3-bolt collector flange outlet.

name: Air Vortex Tube Cooler
description: Compressed air vortex spot cooler, cylindrical stainless steel housing with brass generator orifice, hot air exhaust valve at one end, cold air delivery nozzle at opposite end.

name: Robotic Two-Finger Parallel Gripper
description: Pneumatic parallel jaw gripper module with compact hard-anodized aluminum housing, cross-roller bearing jaw guides, sensor mounting slots on three faces.

name: Ultrasonic Transducer Horn
description: Acoustic booster sonotrode horn with stepped cylindrical profile, 60 mm face diameter, tuned to 20 kHz resonance frequency, Grade 5 titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V.

name: Centrifugal Oil Separator Rotor
description: High-speed conical bowl separator rotor with stacked stainless steel discs, 160 mm OD, dynamically balanced for 9000 RPM, forged duplex stainless steel.

name: Heavy-Duty Clevis Rod End
description: Forged alloy steel rod end clevis with spherical self-lubricating PTFE-lined spherical plain bearing, M16 male threaded shank, yellow zinc chromate plating.

name: Optical Collimator Housing
description: Precision laser collimator cylindrical barrel, 30 mm OD, matte black anodized aluminum 7075, internal fine optical metric threading, anti-reflective micro-baffles.

name: Hydraulic Manifold Block
description: Solid ductile iron hydraulic manifold block, 180 mm x 140 mm x 90 mm, with internal drilled cross-port galleries, 4 cartridge valve cavities, face O-ring subplate mounting.
